detail: storage/strategy_metrics.json does not exist on filesystem and is not tracked by git. The previous ops patrol at 06:04 UTC saw it as fresh (~18s old), suggesting the file is generated ephemerally during certain jobs but not persisted. Strategy metrics are currently unavailable — any feature relying on this file will fail silently.
recommended_action: Investigate which job generates strategy_metrics.json (likely a scheduled compute task). Ensure it runs before each patrol and persists the output. Check if a recent job failed or was skipped.
